zh-CN.name: 销售智能看板
zh-CN.description: 将销售阶段、客户机会、目标和行动线索组织成可操作概览。智能来自真实的数据与分析能力，而不是在普通销售表格上贴“AI”标签。
use_when: 团队需要判断机会进展并安排下一步跟进。
销售阶段、负责人和统计口径已清楚定义。
avoid_when: 不要把模型评分当作已成交概率保证。
敏感客户资料应按任务和权限限制展示。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按销售阶段和责任人组织机会，突出需要跟进的事项和目标差距；说明评分依据与更新时间，将预测和事实区分开；提供进入机会详情的入口，并遵循客户数据访问权限。
专属演示：三个销售阶段与样例机会卡，通过按钮移动一条机会并同步计数。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Sales Intelligence Dashboard
en.description: An actionable overview of sales stages, opportunities, targets and follow-up signals. Intelligence requires actual data and analysis capabilities, not an AI label added to an ordinary sales table.
use_when: Teams need to assess opportunity progress and plan follow-up.
Stages, ownership and measurement definitions are clear.
avoid_when: Do not treat model scores as guaranteed closing probabilities.
Limit sensitive customer information to task and access needs.
en.prompt_template:
Organize opportunities by sales stage and owner, highlighting follow-up needs and target gaps. Explain score basis and update time, separate predictions from facts, provide access to opportunity details, and respect customer-data permissions.
Dedicated demonstration: Three sales stages and sample opportunities; a button moves one opportunity and updates stage counts. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.
